# Getting help with Master CSS

Start with the [installation guide](https://rc.css.master.co/guide/installation)
and [reference](https://rc.css.master.co/reference). Include the Master CSS version
you use when asking for help so readers can distinguish published releases from
the current checkout.

## Questions and ideas

[GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/master-co/css/discussions) is the primary
public support channel. English and Chinese are welcome. Search existing
discussions first, then include your framework, rendering mode, relevant setup,
expected result, actual result, and a small reproduction where possible.

Use the Help category for questions that need an answer. Mark a helpful answer
when your question is resolved. Use Ideas for proposals and General for broader
conversation or sharing your work. Reusable answers may become documentation
after their behavior has been verified.

## Bugs and releases

Use [Issues](https://github.com/master-co/css/issues/new/choose) for reproducible
bugs, documentation errors, and specific implementation requests. Link a related
discussion instead of opening duplicate support requests. See
[Releases](https://github.com/master-co/css/releases) for version changes.

## Discord

[Discord](https://discord.com/invite/sZNKpAAAw6) remains a secondary community space
with existing conversations. Please bring new technical support questions to
Discussions. Maintainers do not promise real-time replies on Discord or a fixed
response time on Discussions. Community members are welcome to help each other.

All channels follow the [Code of Conduct](./CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).

## 中文

技術問題請優先到 [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/master-co/css/discussions)，
可使用中文或英文。提問時附上 Master CSS 版本、框架、渲染模式、預期結果與實際結果，
並盡可能提供最小重現範例。可重現的錯誤請到
[Issues](https://github.com/master-co/css/issues/new/choose) 回報。
Discord 保留既有交流，作為次要社群空間；維護者不承諾即時回覆。
